summary.zh: 用泛型和条件类型写出类型安全的 TS 代码
summary.en: Write type-safe TypeScript with generics and conditional types

description.zh: 覆盖泛型、条件类型、映射类型、模板字面量和工具类型，用来构建可复用的类型工具。适合在 TypeScript 项目里实现复杂类型逻辑，或在编译期约束接口与数据形状。
description.en: Covers generics, conditional and mapped types, template literals, and utility types for reusable helpers. Use it when TypeScript types get complex or interfaces need compile-time guarantees.
